caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular panels arranged in two rows of three, each displaying a different decorative pattern. The top left panel features vertical stripes in tan, black, orange, and white, with a floral motif of orange and black flowers and leafy branches along a cream background. The top center panel shows a geometric plaid pattern in black, tan, and white, using a mix of straight and wavy lines. The top right panel is composed of vertical stripes in various shades of brown and pink, with small diamond and dot patterns within some of the brown stripes. The bottom left panel depicts a tan background with a central vertical blue geometric chain design and faint white swirls. The bottom center panel displays a repeating wavy vertical pattern in orange, red, white, and black, with black and white flowers inside circular motifs. The bottom right panel has a simple white background with scattered black floral sprigs. All panels are bordered by a plain, off-white background.
title: Materials from Quilt
